answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive experiments across various domain-specific generation tasks, including Medical Question Answering (QA), Legal QA, and Code Generation tasks...
answer_1.outputs: synthetic query–response pairs used for fine‑tuning the target LLM

answer_2.quote: For the evaluation of the QA task, we employ the ROUGE-1 (R1), ROUGE-L (RL), and Perplexity (PPL) as metrics... For the code generation task, we use Pass@1 and Pass@10 as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: We also use an LLM‑Judge to assess the generated response from our method and those baseline approaches for QA tasks... we provide the LLM‑Judge with responses from our method and those from baseline methods, prompting it to judge which response is better.
